summary: Add native GUI and minimal text installer selection. API impact: none; boot media and local installer only.

guide.reason: Operators choose graphical or text installation and need keyboard/mouse and graphics fallback instructions. Both install the same headless Nex host.

api.reason: Boot menus select Debian frontends; existing local preseed/hooks configure the OS. No Controller operation, Core command/result or client API exists in this flow.

verification.method: Build actual ISO; run installer policy/account checks, diskless BIOS/UEFI frontend capture, graphical password/disk walkthrough and offline installed-host smoke. Inspect captures and log markers; limits recorded in QA.
